title: Cherry Clafoutis
blurb: A classic French baked dessert with sweet cherries suspended in a light, custardy batter
steps: Heat your oven to 180°C and grease a shallow baking dish with the butter.
Wash the cherries and pat them dry, then arrange them in a single layer in the prepared dish.
Whisk together the flour, sugar and salt in a mixing bowl.
Beat the eggs in a separate bowl, then whisk in the cream, milk and vanilla extract.
Pour the egg mixture into the flour mixture and whisk until you have a smooth batter with no lumps.
Pour the batter over the cherries in the dish, ensuring they are mostly covered.
Bake for 30 minutes until the clafoutis is puffed and golden, with the centre just set.
Let it cool for 10 minutes before serving warm or at room temperature.

ingredients.text: butter, unsalted, to grease the dish
